meta.name: ASA
meta.description: ASA — migrated verbatim from tools/material_db.json (typical desktop-FDM datasheet-class values) plus the heat-set pull-out table from joint_check.py. Poisson is a typical thermoplastic value (absent from material_db). Thermal-transport fields are null: not present in the migrated source, not invented.

sn_curve.note: engineering rule of thumb (~1e6-cycle allowable = ultimate x knockdown), NOT a measured S-N curve

anisotropy.model: scalar-tier direction heuristic (production_check.py): across-layer (Z) tensile strength / in-plane (XY) strength; applied when the primary load is > threshold deg out of the layer plane

heatset_pullout_n.note: brass knurled heat-set at standard insert length; conservative low ends (joint_check.py)

sources.mechanical.poisson: typical thermoplastic (material_db.json has no poisson); provided for FEA
sources._db_source_note: typical ASA datasheets (Prusament ASA tensile ~45 MPa, HDT-B ~93 C); ABS-like with better UV stability and slightly better layer bonding.
sources.thermal.conductivity_w_mk: 0.17 W/mK (Medium confidence): NETZSCH polymer database ASA 0.17-0.19 https://polymers.netzsch.com/Materials/Details/3 (page blocks fetch; via search snippet), consistent with the ABS-family chart values (Professional Plastics https://www.professionalplastics.com/professionalplastics/ThermalPropertiesofPlasticMaterials.pdf)
sources.thermal.specific_heat_j_kgk: 1300 J/kgK — SINGLE SOURCE, Low confidence, flagged per research doctrine: NETZSCH ASA cp 1.3-1.4 J/gK https://polymers.netzsch.com/Materials/Details/3 ; no independent second ASA cp found 2026-07-30 (ABS-family analogy is consistent but not independent)
sources.thermal.tg_or_melt_c: Tg 98 C (DSC), Polymaker ASA TDS https://wiki.polymaker.com/polymaker-products/more-about-our-products/documents/technical-data-sheets/abs-asa/polymaker-tm-asa ; generic ASA ~100 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Acrylonitrile_styrene_acrylate
sources.thermal.softening_c: softening_c = conservative softening allowable for sustained-load design: the LOW end of min(Tg, HDT-B 0.45 MPa) across cited brand TDS values for this material class (degC). ASA: 96 C = Stratasys FDM ASA, PRINTED specimens, HDT 0.45 MPa ASTM D648 https://www.stratasys.com/siteassets/materials/materials-catalog/fdm-materials/asa/mds_fdm_asa_0921a.pdf ; Bambu ASA V2 100 C https://www.additive-x.com/shop/media/mageplaza/product_attachments/attachment_file/b/a/bambu_asa_technical_data_sheet_1.pdf ; Polymaker 103 C ISO 75
sources.thermal._printed_anisotropy_note: printed parts conduct WORSE than bulk, direction-dependent: inter-layer thermal contact resistance dominates through-thickness conduction (Prajapati et al., Additive Manufacturing 2018, https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S2214860417305456); voids/porosity measurably reduce heat transmission even at 100% infill (Entropy 24:654 2022, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9141791/); through-plane k reported ~20-40% below in-plane in FDM literature (secondary synthesis, primaries paywalled — treat percentage as indicative). Records store the conservative-LOW isotropic value.
sources.thermal._cp_temperature_note: cp is strongly temperature-dependent (amorphous polymers jump +30-50% crossing Tg; Covestro shows TPU cp +~15% from 20C to 80C) — record values are ROOM-TEMPERATURE-class unless noted
